preconditions.expression: 1 <= T <= 250 and all(1 <= len(S) <= 60 and 1 <= len(P) <= 60 for S, P in test_cases)
preconditions.description: T is the number of test cases (1 ≤ T ≤ 250), and each string S and P has length between 1 and 60 (inclusive).

preconditions.expression: all(S.isalpha() and P.isalpha() for S, P in test_cases)
preconditions.description: All characters in S and P are alphabetic (a-z, A-Z).

postconditions.expression: len(P) == 2 * len(S) and any(P == S[:i] + S + S[i:] for i in range(len(S) + 1))
postconditions.description: P is a possible password if and only if its length is exactly twice the length of S, and P can be formed by inserting a copy of S into S at any position (including start or end).
